header.title: Spotlight
header.description: Circular light that follows the pointer. `variant` sets the look (`reveal`, `glow` or `ring`) and `trigger` when it moves: `hover` (default), `always` or `press`. The layer ignores pointer events, so the content stays interactive.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine props and move the pointer over the card. `size` set to `auto` lets `intensity` pick the radius (120, 180 or 280 px).

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `reveal` darkens everything with a veil and leaves a hole of light, like a flashlight. `glow` adds a bloom under the cursor with no veil. `ring` draws a ring of light around the pointer.

image.title: Over an image
image.description: `Spotlight` wraps a native `img`. With `reveal`, move the pointer to uncover the image under the veil.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: `hover` follows the pointer while it's over the target. `always` keeps a light at the center and moves it with the pointer. `press` only lights while you hold the pointer down.

size.title: Size
size.description: `size` is the light radius. A number is pixels; any CSS length also works. Without `size`, the radius comes from `intensity`.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: `intensity` sets the light strength and, for `reveal`, how dark the veil is. Without `size`, it also changes the radius. Takes a token or a number between `0` and `1`.

color.title: Colors
color.description: `color` tints the light for `glow` and `ring`. `veilColor` changes the `reveal` veil. Prefer your app's palette tokens.

state.title: Paused and disabled
state.description: `isPaused` freezes the light where it is: move the pointer and turn on pause. `isDisabled` hides the light and keeps the content interactive.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onSpotlight` fires when the light starts following the pointer and `outSpotlight` when it turns off, with the cause in `event.reason`. The layer has `pointer-events: none`: the button still gets clicks.

texts.body: Hover the card and watch the log.

hook.title: useSpotlight
hook.description: Headless version. The hook returns `ref`, `style` (with `--gemfx-spotlight-x` and `-y`), `pointerProps` and `pose`; you render the markup and the layer. Use it to read the position or mount the light on your own element.

header.title: Spotlight API
header.description: Reference for `Spotlight` props, the `useSpotlight` hook, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for each variant and trigger.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/spotlight` with its `spotlight.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

hook.description: Takes the same options as `Spotlight` except `children`, `asChild`, `className`, `classNames` and `ref` (`UseSpotlightOptions`). You render the host, `.gemfx-spotlight__surface` and the layer with `.gemfx-spotlight__beam`.

result.ref: Ref for the host. Used to measure the box when computing the position.
result.style: Inline styles with the `--gemfx-spotlight-*` variables. Already includes the `style` you passed.
result.pointerProps: Pointer handlers for the host. They call the ones you passed in the options first.
result.motionClassName: `gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion` when you pass `ignoreReducedMotion`. Add it to the host.
result.pose: Light position as a percentage of the box (`x`, `y`) and its opacity (`strength`).
result.isTracking: `true` while the light follows the pointer.
result.isHover: `trigger` is `hover` and the effect is active.
result.isAlways: `trigger` is `always` and the effect is active.
result.isPress: `trigger` is `press` and the effect is active.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> except color, and passes them to the root div (or the child, with asChild). The onPointerEnter, onPointerLeave, onPointerMove, onPointerDown, onPointerUp and onPointerCancel handlers run before the effect's own logic.

items.hidden: The light layer has aria-hidden and pointer-events: none: it's decorative and doesn't block interaction.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the light stops following the pointer. With always it stays at the center; with hover and press it isn't shown.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) forces tracking. Use it only when motion is essential.
items.pointerOnly: The light only follows the pointer: there's no keyboard equivalent. Don't put information that is only visible under the light.
items.touch: By default (disabledOnTouch) touch is ignored; mouse and pen keep working. That way it doesn't fight scrolling on mobile.
items.press: With press, pressing on a nested control (button, a, input…) doesn't light the beam, so the control works as usual.
items.contrast: reveal darkens content outside the light. If there's text that must be read, check its contrast against the veil or use glow.

items.tracking: Added while the light follows the pointer. Shortens the transition to 80 ms.
items.inactive: Added with `isActive={false}` or `isDisabled`; hides the light.
items.disabled: Added with `isDisabled`. Removes the pointer cursor.
items.surface: Wraps the child, below the layer.
items.layer: Absolute layer above the child that holds the light.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: `size`, `duration`, `delay`, the position and `strength` are written inline on every render, so a class can't override them. `color` and `veil` are only written when you pass the prop.

items.color: Light color for `glow` and `ring`. Set by `color`; default `var(--gem-palette-primary-200)`.
items.veil: Veil color for `reveal`. Set by `veilColor`; default `var(--gem-palette-neutral-950)`.
items.size: Light radius. Set by `size` or, without it, by `intensity`.
items.duration: Fade when appearing or returning to rest. Set by `duration`; default `220ms`.
items.delay: Delay before the light appears. Set by `delay`; default `0ms`.
items.position: Light position, as a percentage of the box.
items.strength: Light opacity: `0` at rest and the `intensity` peak while tracking.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables Spotlight reads as defaults.

items.palette: Default light color, with a fallback when gem-system isn't loaded.

content.title: Content
content.description: What gets lit and where the effect mounts.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Light shape, colors, radius and intensity.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When it follows the pointer and how it pauses or turns off.

items.children: Content the light is cast over.
items.asChild: Applies the effect to the single child, without a wrapping `div`.
items.variant: `reveal` (veil with a hole of light), `glow` (bloom with no veil) or `ring` (annulus).
items.color: Light color for `glow` and `ring`. Prefer host tokens. An empty string uses the default.
items.size: Light radius. A number is pixels. Without a value, `intensity` sets it: `120`, `180` or `280`.
items.intensity: Light strength and, for `reveal`, veil darkness. Token or number between `0` and `1`.
items.duration: Fade when appearing or returning to rest. While tracking, the transition drops to 80 ms.
items.trigger: `hover` follows the pointer while it's over the target, `always` keeps a light at the center and moves it with the pointer, `press` only while the pointer is down.
items.isActive: Lets the effect run. `false` hides the light and `outSpotlight` gets `inactive`.
items.isPaused: Freezes the light at its current position.
items.isDisabled: Hides the light; the content stays interactive. `outSpotlight` gets `disabled`.
items.disabledOnTouch: Ignores touch pointers. Mouse and pen keep working.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Follows the pointer even when the user prefers reduced motion. Only when motion is essential.
items.onSpotlight: Fires when the light turns on: when tracking starts with `hover` or `press`, or on mount with `always`.
items.outSpotlight: Fires when the light turns off: on pointer leave, on release with `press`, when disabled or on unmount.
items.style: Root inline styles. Merged with the `--gemfx-spotlight-*` variables.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
